newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close flat on blue chip decline.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close flat on blue chip decline.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks, restrained by a decline in a highly capitalised blue chip, closed barely moved, but turnover was high on local buying, brokers said.

The all share index closed 0.41 points higher at 617.93. Commercial Bank rose five rupees to 141, Cold Stores three to 80. A price fall in blue chip National Development Bank held back the index, brokers said.
"We introduced a parcel of 32,500 National Development Bank at 195, but underselling brought the price down to 190," said Gordon Nadesan, a trader at CT Smith Stock Brokers.
Turnover was a healthy 69.9 million rupees on 1.7 million shares, led by 81,000 Development Finance at 269.50 rupees.
"There is overall buying because the index is expected to move up, even into the 640-point range, by the end of the month," said Shafi Waheed, a trader CDIC Sasoon Cumberbatch.
"But the rise will not be smooth," he added. "It will be punctuated by profit taking."
